fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: Eight minutes from the Waterford estate sits a practice that can cover a household's entire dental life - check-ups and cleans, children's visits, fillings and crowns, implants, braces and clear aligners, and emergencies when they arrive.

fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: For anyone arriving from another area, the first appointment is about getting the picture straight rather than starting work. You will leave knowing exactly what is going on and what the options are, with the priorities set out in writing.

fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: Tooth n Care has been on Lawes Street for years. Dr Nish, with almost ten years behind him and a special interest in veneers, wisdom teeth, dentures and full-mouth rehabilitation, works alongside Dr Nav, a Fellow of the Royal Australasian College of Dental Surgeons. Zoe handles preventative and general dentistry for every age.

fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: We live and work here. Over the years that has meant sponsoring local sport, supporting community groups and school events, and looking after several generations of the same families. It also means nobody is going to sell you something you do not need, because we will see you again at the shops.

fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: New to the area? This is the straightforward way to begin with us.

fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: Your first visit covers a full exam, treatment plan, X-rays, scale and clean, and fluoride - no-gap with a participating health fund, or a flat $199 without cover.

fields.label: Small print
fields.value: New patients only. A $50 deposit applies and comes off your visit. Any treatment recommended beyond the first visit is quoted separately. See full offer details and terms.

fields.label: Text
fields.value: We have just moved here. How do we transfer to your practice?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Book an appointment and that is it. Records and recent X-rays from your previous dentist are useful, though not necessary.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Five kilometres, so around eight minutes.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We are, every week - individuals, walk-ins and whole families alike.

fields.label: Text
fields.value: Can everyone in the household be seen here?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Yes. General, preventative, cosmetic, restorative and orthodontic care are all provided in the one practice, for every age.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: There is, on site at Lawes Street.

fields.label: Text
fields.value: What if something goes wrong between appointments?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Ring {{site:phone}}. Part of each day is kept free for problems that will not wait.
